claim.quote: this new measurement confirms our previous observation that the (J/psi)/Drell-Yan cross-sections ratio departs from the normal nuclear absorption pattern for semi-central Pb-Pb collisions

name: NA50 J/psi suppression in Pb-Pb collisions: year-2000 data

summary.plain: A new NA50 measurement with the target in vacuum confirmed that J/psi production is normal in the most peripheral lead-lead collisions but departs from normal nuclear absorption in semi-central ones and keeps decreasing with centrality.
summary.technical: J/psi production in Pb-Pb at 158 GeV/nucleon from the year-2000 data sample taken with the target system in vacuum: the (J/psi)/Drell-Yan ratio in the most peripheral collisions matches the nuclear absorption pattern from proton-nucleus data, and departs from it for semi-central collisions, decreasing persistently with centrality.

title: A new measurement of J/psi suppression in Pb-Pb collisions at 158 GeV per nucleon
why_it_matters: Closed the question whether the apparent suppression in peripheral collisions was due to interactions in air, supporting the anomalous-suppression pattern.
